tasha: quick heads-up — noticed a p99 TTFT spike on the token-level SLO dashboard for eu-west yesterday evening. looks tied to a tokens/sec surge on atlas-shard-4. can we decide on alert tuning + a short drill to confirm it's noise vs real capacity issue? :thinking_face:

ben: saw that. grafana alert fired around 21:14 UTC. region metric shows pkts dropped ~0.3% during the window, might be transient NIC queuing. tagging net team.

mike: sharing the two panels' queries i used (promql):

```
# p99 TTFT (TTFT in seconds)
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region, shard))

# tokens/sec per shard
sum(rate(tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (region, shard)
```

mike: quick idea for alerts: set TTFT p99 alert threshold to 450ms for 5m (candidate), but require tokens/sec > 100k concurrently to avoid noise. i.e. only fire if both conditions true for 3-5m. reduces false positives when single noisy request inflates p99.

tasha: that conditional firing makes sense. ben — can you confirm network drop events coincided with the TTFT window? if so we should annotate the dashboard and suppress new alerts for the same root cause while we investigate NIC/driver.

ben: confirmed — we have a small NIC rx_error spike on host eu-west-4-12 between 21:12-21:16. looks like a driver interrupt storm on that host. opened infra ticket INFRA-6743 and added host to maintenance.

ops-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: token-ttft-p99-eu-west fired (2334509951). details: p99=0.52s, tokens/sec=128,400, affected_shard=atlas-shard-4. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ttft-tokenflow

lucy: can we add a cheap guard: require tokens/sec > 90k for at least 3m AND p99 > 450ms for >5m before paging on pagerduty? otherwise send a slack-only notification to #eng-platform. reduces wakeups for small transient NIC blips.

mike: +1. proposed alert expr (pseudo):
```
alert: TokenTTFTP99High
expr: (
  histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, region, shard)) > 0.45
) and (
  sum(rate(tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (region, shard) > 90000
)
for: 5m
```
annotations: runbook -> https://wiki.redwood.example/runbooks/token-ttft

tasha: nice. next steps: 1) ben will keep host in maintenance and confirm post-fix metrics tomorrow. 2) mike to stage alert change in dev grafana and link to runbook. 3) lucy to draft a brief postmortem note if we see recurrence. i'll schedule a 15m drill on Monday to validate the new alert gating. thanks all :thumbsup:

ben: noted. putting INFRA-6743 status -> in-progress. will update when NIC driver rolled back.

mike: i'll push the staged rule to the dev notification channel and ping here when it's live.

ops-bot: NOTE: Incident annotation added to dashboard (2334509968) by ben: "NIC driver interrupt storm; host in maintenance."
